base: Apron; PP is the standard method selection
source_package_extra_members: 24 saved NPY waveforms and build-command.json were added to the handoff package and were not entries in the original run manifest. The 24 NPY SHA256 values each match UTMOS and ECAPA individual records; the build command SHA256 matches frozen.json. The package SHA256 covers all 4356 entries.

original_source_file_map.run/manifest.json: original sealed run manifest, SHA256 above
original_source_file_map.run/quality/values/**/*.json: quality-values.json.gz entries preserve each original JSON object, relative name, and SHA256
original_source_file_map.run/native/{case}/{condition}/wave_{pitc: audio-manifest.json identifies each private full waveform by relative name and SHA256; only the first five seconds of each appears as WAV

higher_precision_50_digit_comparison.note: With Decimal precision 50, unrounded means retain further digits beyond the original precision-28 saved means. No source values were changed.

diagnostic_scope: Only saved Layer1 F0, Rd, vocal tract magnitude, and source harmonic phase. Unsaved HM, residual, and PSD are not claimed equal.
historical_first_run: Separate initial run reached 3115 of 4320 quality values at its 3600-second child limit; 1205 remained unexecuted. None were imported into the complete rerun.
source_reference_html: run/index.html is an original private report; this publication is an independently audited derived report.
